how_its_made:
Architecture Overview
We built Agentic-DeFi as a three-tier system that bridges AI intelligence with blockchain execution:
Multi-Agent Coordination
We implemented three types of agent coordination:
Sequential: Agents execute in order (e.g., Risk → Yield → Execution)
Parallel: Agents run simultaneously for independent analysis
Hierarchical: Master agent coordinates specialized sub-agents
